entities.summary: Rushan Rafikov is a Russian ice hockey player of Tatar descent. He is currently playing with Lokomotiv Yaroslavl of the Kontinental Hockey League. Rafikov was selected by the Calgary Flames in the seventh round of the 2013 NHL Entry Draft.
